records.Subject: Shipment tracking portal returns 500 error
records.Description: Customer portal tracking page fails with a server error for all shipments since this morning's release.

records.Subject: Delivery scanner not syncing with dispatch
records.Description: Handheld scanners at the Gary depot stop syncing after about 20 minutes; drivers re-scan manually.

records.Subject: Request for additional user licenses
records.Description: Customer wants 15 more licenses for the new Milwaukee hub before month end.

records.Subject: Invoice shows duplicate fuel surcharge
records.Description: September invoice lists the fuel surcharge twice; customer requests a credit memo.

records.Subject: Password reset email never arrives
records.Description: IT lead reports reset emails are not delivered to their domain; possibly blocked by their spam filter.

records.Subject: Patient intake kiosk freezes at check-in
records.Description: Two kiosks in the east wing freeze on the insurance card scan step several times a day.

records.Subject: HL7 interface dropping lab results
records.Description: Some lab result messages are not reaching the EHR; affects about 3% of messages since Tuesday.

records.Subject: Billing export missing CPT codes
records.Description: Monthly billing export omits CPT codes for telehealth visits.

records.Subject: Training session for new billing staff
records.Description: Requesting a 1-hour onboarding session for three new billing coordinators.

records.Subject: Badge printer installation at new clinic
records.Description: Need setup assistance for the badge printer at the Cambridge satellite clinic.

records.Subject: POS terminals offline in two stores
records.Description: Payment terminals in stores 14 and 22 lost connectivity; stores are taking cash only.

records.Subject: Inventory counts out of sync after update
records.Description: Stock levels in the back office differ from the POS after last night's update.

records.Subject: Damaged shelving units on delivery
records.Description: Six shelving units arrived with bent brackets; customer wants replacements.

records.Subject: Question about volume discount terms
records.Description: Procurement asks whether the volume discount applies to the Q4 seasonal order.

records.Subject: Self-checkout scale calibration
records.Description: Self-checkout scales at store 8 reject produce items as unexpected weight.

records.Subject: Conveyor motor overheating on line 3
records.Description: Motor trips the thermal cutoff after roughly 2 hours of operation; production is reduced.

records.Subject: Control panel firmware upgrade failed
records.Description: Upgrade to firmware 4.2 failed halfway; panel boots into recovery mode.

records.Subject: Hydraulic press leaking fluid
records.Description: Small but steady hydraulic leak near the main cylinder seal on press 2.

records.Subject: Feedback on new maintenance dashboard
records.Description: Plant engineer suggests adding mean time between failures to the dashboard.

records.Subject: Wiring diagram request for packaging unit
records.Description: Customer needs the updated wiring diagram for the packaging unit, revision C.
